investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: What is the role of ANA in autoimmune serology?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: The screening test for connective tissue disease (especially SLE). It is sensitive but non-specific (also positive in healthy/elderly people), so a positive ANA prompts titre/pattern and specific antibodies (ENA, dsDNA).

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Which antibody is specific for SLE and tracks disease activity?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: Anti-dsDNA — specific for SLE and correlates with disease activity and lupus nephritis. (Anti-Sm is also highly specific.)

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: How do ANCA subtypes map to the vasculitides?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: cANCA / anti-PR3 → granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA). pANCA / anti-MPO → microscopic polyangiitis (MPA) and eosinophilic GPA (EGPA).

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Compare rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP in rheumatoid arthritis.
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: RF is non-specific (also Sjögren's, healthy people). Anti-CCP is specific for RA and prognostic (erosive disease).

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Which autoantibodies point to primary biliary cholangitis and autoimmune hepatitis?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: AMA (anti-mitochondrial) → primary biliary cholangitis. ASMA (type 1) and anti-LKM (type 2) → autoimmune hepatitis.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: When is the ENA panel sent, and what does anti-Ro/anti-La indicate?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: After a positive ANA. Anti-Ro (SSA)/anti-La (SSB) → Sjögren's (also SLE). Anti-Ro crosses the placenta → neonatal lupus / congenital heart block.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Which ENA antibody is highly specific for SLE?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: Anti-Sm (Smith) — highly specific for SLE (though present in only a minority).

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: How do anti-Scl-70 and anti-centromere distinguish scleroderma subtypes?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: Anti-Scl-70 → diffuse systemic sclerosis (lung fibrosis, renal crisis). Anti-centromere → limited systemic sclerosis / CREST (pulmonary hypertension).
Polymyositis / dermatomyositis — part of the antisynthetase syndrome (interstitial lung disease, mechanic's hands, Raynaud's).

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Which antibody is associated with mixed connective tissue disease?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: Anti-U1-RNP (high titre) is characteristic of mixed connective tissue disease.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.front: Why do anti-Ro-positive pregnant women need extra monitoring?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.back: Anti-Ro/La cross the placenta and can cause neonatal lupus and congenital complete heart block — so fetal cardiac monitoring is arranged.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A 25-year-old woman has a malar rash, arthralgia and a positive ANA. Which antibody is most specific for SLE and correlates with activity?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: Anti-dsDNA is specific for SLE and tracks disease activity/lupus nephritis. ANA is sensitive but non-specific; anti-Sm is also highly specific but does not track activity.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A patient with sinusitis, haemoptysis and rapidly progressive renal impairment is cANCA/anti-PR3 positive. Which diagnosis does this suggest?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: cANCA/anti-PR3 with upper and lower respiratory involvement plus glomerulonephritis is classic GPA. pANCA/anti-MPO is associated with MPA and EGPA.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A middle-aged woman has cholestatic LFTs, pruritus and a positive anti-mitochondrial antibody. What is the likely diagnosis?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: AMA positivity with a cholestatic picture and pruritus in a middle-aged woman is characteristic of primary biliary cholangitis.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A pregnant woman with Sjögren's syndrome is anti-Ro (SSA) positive. What is the main fetal risk to monitor for?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: Anti-Ro (and anti-La) cross the placenta and can cause neonatal lupus and congenital complete heart block, so fetal cardiac monitoring is arranged.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A patient with systemic sclerosis has widespread skin involvement and is anti-Scl-70 positive. Which complications is this subtype most associated with?
options: Lung fibrosis and scleroderma renal crisis (diffuse disease)
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.answer: Lung fibrosis and scleroderma renal crisis (diffuse disease)
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: Anti-Scl-70 marks diffuse systemic sclerosis, which carries the risk of interstitial lung fibrosis and scleroderma renal crisis. Anti-centromere marks limited disease (CREST) with a pulmonary hypertension risk.

investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.question: A patient with proximal muscle weakness, raised CK and interstitial lung disease is anti-Jo-1 positive. What is the underlying condition?
investigations__IMMUNOLOGY / SEROLOGY__C.explanation: Anti-Jo-1 defines the antisynthetase syndrome — myositis with interstitial lung disease, mechanic's hands and Raynaud's.
